endorsements.name: Dhia Mahjoub
endorsements.label: Investigating Web3 with OSINT
endorsements.description: Web3 introduces various innovations such as new stores of value and digital assets trading, DeFi and the token economy. Unfortunately, these novel services are tarnished by rampant speculation, fraud and hacks. In this session, using public sources and online free tools, we will debunk the FUD around web3 by discussing the fundamentals: This talk will feature practical examples and use cases destined to both technical and non-technical audiences who are seeking clarity and perspective. We hope attendees leave with useful knowledge and start productive discussions.

endorsements.subtitle: HITB 2023
